notes.subject: אדירים/אדיר
notes.rationale: Alliterative repetition of אדיר 'mighty' applied first to the breakers then to Jaħwe — He out-mighties the mighty; kept as qawwija/qawwi.

notes.subject: comparative syntax
notes.rationale: Hebrew has no 'than' or 'above': KJV supplies 'mightier than', JPS/ASV 'above'; Maltese renders the bare juxtaposition with a dash, leaving the comparison implicit.

notes.subject: משברי
notes.rationale: מִשְׁבָּר is a sea-breaker (from שבר 'to break'), rendered imġiebaħ 'waves' — the breaking image is softened.

translation: Mil-ħsejjes ta' l-ilmijiet in-numrużi, l-imġiebaħ qawwija tal-baħar — qawwi fl-ogħla għoli Jaħwe.
